changes: Gave Friday the 13th its own hockey-mask sticker and steel frame, distinct from Castlevania and Halloween.
Separated seven duplicated event-sticker pairs: April/rainy days, June/July, October/November, December/New Year, January/Kirby, Friday/Castlevania and Metroidvania/Metroid.
Retained other artwork and checked all 41 active themes for unique visible frame and sticker assets.
Introduced restrained metal arcade navigation and matching statistics hardware, with complete display borders and a transparent navigation backdrop.
Aligned Now Playing and Play Next panels, covers and text in populated and empty states; added quiet platform-matched gameplay snapshots with a plain fallback.
Applied pixel UI typography while retaining readable descriptions and catalog field values; standardized metadata chips, Reset filters and catalog header artwork.
Replaced seasonal heading emojis with event stickers while retaining translated names; introduced a keyboard-accessible themed collection chooser and matching By calendar control.
Balanced calendar year controls, removed duplicate Current year, and matched scrollbars to the active theme.
Aligned complete seasonal rails to their scene boundaries, preserved projecting corners with spacing, and prevented mobile min-content expansion.
Kept all 41 backgrounds distinct; replaced only the Metroid anniversary Gothic scene with an alien research station.
Restored the drawn unlit G/A artwork while retaining the original sign backing; fitted the counter scan to its inner rails and retained lifted seasonal cards without top clipping.
Centered cassette display rows, expanded safe sticker positions while excluding controls, reels, the title strip and bottom rail, and retained static reels.
Added a symmetric 48×48 back-to-top silhouette and event-coordinated skins; refined Halloween to dark violet and pumpkin orange.
TV opens unmuted at a quiet 15% volume through the official player API and cancels late starts after closing.

Aligned outer seasonal rails with the shared block column, completed music track borders, standardized pixel close icons and text-only controls, and fixed catalog overflow at intermediate viewport widths.

Removed the home recommendation footer, balanced descriptions and metadata spacing across all game lists, restored proportional TV-style close icons and pixel-snapped the moving counter sweep to its glass.
Redrew the 16-bit TV with a broader crochet doily and reference-based antenna; added one round power control with drawn on/off lamp states and equal hardware spacing.
Enlarged the mobile cartridge-and-book logo into a centered row, preserving clear spacing around the title, controls and achievement screen; desktop header unchanged.
Added 439 concise platform-matched catalog synopses in a separate editorial field, preserving personal library notes and saved progress.
Aligned catalog card edges to the shared navigation column, and restored stacked cover/text cards on narrow phones.
Kept the play-status field compact beside a readable rating source; aligned status glyphs, rating stars, equal-step year digits and inset dropdown arrows.
Added local transparent console photographs with credits, a single scrollable release timeline, larger years and centered gallery arrows.
Removed the counter padding-edge clip so single and double scan bands reach the actual inner frame rails; verified moving frames on phone and desktop.
